herbs.name: Blazing Star
herbs.description: Blazing Star stands out with its tall stalks topped with bright purple blooms that attract various pollinators.

herbs.name: Bogmoss
herbs.description: Bogmoss is a dense, dark green moss that clings to rocks and tree stumps. It's always wet, exuding a musty, earthy aroma.

herbs.name: Canopy Thistle
herbs.description: Canopy Thistle grows high up in the trees, often at the forest canopy level, with spiky, upward-stretching leaves.

herbs.name: Cave Moss
herbs.description: Cave Moss covers large areas of cave walls and floors. It is spongy and dense, with a deep green color that appears almost black in the cave's low light.

herbs.name: Cinderstem
herbs.description: Cinderstem is a tough, resilient herb that can survive even near volcanic vents in the desert. It has a scorched, blackened stem.

herbs.name: Coralweed
herbs.description: Coralweed resembles underwater coral but grows above water on rocky outcroppings along the beach. It is colorful and hard to the touch.

herbs.name: Dreadcap
herbs.description: This mushroom has a wide, flat cap that is a dull brown color, often covered in a layer of marsh slime. It prefers the darkest, wettest parts of the marsh.

herbs.name: Dripstone Bloom
herbs.description: This rare herb forms beneath dripping stalactites, capturing minerals from the water. It crystallizes into beautiful, gem-like structures on its petals.

herbs.name: Dunebrush
herbs.description: Dunebrush is a wiry, sprawling shrub with needle-like leaves that minimize water loss. It grows low to the ground to avoid the wind.

herbs.name: Dustbloom
herbs.description: Dustbloom has delicate, dust-colored petals that blend perfectly with the sandy surroundings, helping it avoid notice.

herbs.name: Earthtongue
herbs.description: Earthtongue grows low to the ground with broad, flat leaves that are a deep green, almost blending into the grass around it.

herbs.name: Echo Fungus
herbs.description: Echo Fungus grows in the deeper, quieter parts of caves. Its cap vibrates slightly, producing echoes that some believe help in navigating the labyrinthine passages.

herbs.name: Echoflower
herbs.description: Echoflower has delicate, bell-shaped violet petals and emits soft, echoing sounds when disturbed, believed to mimic cave sounds to deter predators.

herbs.name: Fenflower
herbs.description: Fenflower sprouts small, luminescent purple blossoms that light up the marsh at night. It grows in clumps and has a gelatinous stem.

herbs.name: Foamroot
herbs.description: Foamroot is often found buried in sandy soils, with only its white, fluffy roots exposed above ground, resembling sea foam.

herbs.name: Frostfern
herbs.description: Frostfern has icy blue leaves and thrives in cold patches of the forest, especially near frost-covered areas.

herbs.name: Frostnip
herbs.description: Frostnip blossoms in early spring, with tiny white flowers that can survive late frost. It's often the first sign of green in the grasslands after winter.

herbs.name: Gloomroot
herbs.description: Gloomroot is a pale, almost translucent plant that thrives in the dimmest parts of caves. Its leaves are thin and slightly luminescent, providing a faint light.

herbs.name: Glowcap
herbs.description: Glowcap mushrooms emit a soft, bioluminescent glow, illuminating cave passages with a pale blue light. They grow in clusters on damp cave walls.

herbs.name: Goldenrod
herbs.description: Goldenrod is easily identifiable by its bright yellow flowers that bloom in dense clusters. It grows abundantly in sunny spots.

herbs.name: Heartroot
herbs.description: Heartroot is a robust plant with deep red roots, usually found near the base of ancient trees where the soil is rich and fertile.

herbs.name: Ironshroud Mold
herbs.description: Ironshroud Mold forms a dense, metallic-looking layer over rocks and cave floors. It is tough and resilient, with a texture similar to cast iron.

herbs.name: Ironwood Sprig
herbs.description: Ironwood Sprig comes from a rare, hardy bush with wood-like stems. It prefers the denser parts of the forest.

herbs.name: Mirage Mint
herbs.description: Mirage Mint is known for its hallucinogenic properties. It has silvery leaves that reflect light, often making it appear as a mirage from a distance.

herbs.name: Mireweed
herbs.description: Mireweed has broad, flat leaves that float on the surface of marsh waters. Its roots delve deep into the underwater soil, absorbing nutrients.

herbs.name: Mistvine
herbs.description: Mistvine is a light green vine that grows in misty areas of the forest, often near streams or waterfalls. It exudes a faint, calming aroma.

herbs.name: Nightshade Cactus
herbs.description: Unlike typical cacti, the Nightshade Cactus blooms only at night, featuring deep purple flowers and a thick, water-storing base.

herbs.name: Prairie Sage
herbs.description: This herb has a strong aromatic presence with silvery-green leaves and is often used to mark territory borders due to its potent scent.

herbs.name: Quicksand Root
herbs.description: This herb grows around areas of loose sand, anchoring itself deeply into the earth. It has a thick, tuberous root.

herbs.name: Saltvine
herbs.description: This sturdy herb grows close to the shoreline, its leaves thick and waxy to retain moisture. It has a silvery-green hue and emits a salty scent.

herbs.name: Searing Thistle
herbs.description: This herb has fiery red thorns and thrives in the hottest parts of the desert, often found near heat vents or sun-baked stones.

herbs.name: Shadowleaf
herbs.description: Shadowleaf is a dark green, almost black herb that thrives in the shadows of towering trees. It has velvety leaves that absorb light.

herbs.name: Skybloom
herbs.description: Skybloom has delicate blue flowers that seem to mirror the color of the sky. It prefers high, windy plateaus.

herbs.name: Sporepuff
herbs.description: This large, bulbous mushroom releases clouds of spores when disturbed. It has a spongy texture and a deep green color.

herbs.name: Stalagtide Sprout
herbs.description: This herb grows around the base of stalagmites, featuring a hard, crusty exterior that blends well with its rocky surroundings.

herbs.name: Stormleaf
herbs.description: This herb thrives in areas frequently hit by sea storms. It has dark, serrated leaves that can withstand strong winds and saltwater spray.

herbs.name: Sunberry Bush
herbs.description: This herb bears bright, golden berries and flourishes in patches of sunlight that break through the forest canopy.

herbs.name: Sunscorch Bloom
herbs.description: This vibrant orange flower thrives under the intense desert sun, its petals tough and leathery to conserve moisture.

herbs.name: Swampthorn
herbs.description: Swampthorn bushes bear sharp thorns and have a robust, vine-like quality that allows them to wrap around other plants and trees for support.

herbs.name: Thundersprout
herbs.description: This rare herb is said to only grow where lightning has struck. It has a charged appearance, with crackling energy around its stems when touched.

herbs.name: Tideblossom
herbs.description: Tideblossom features vibrant blue petals that bloom only during high tide. The stems are long and flexible, swaying with the ocean's currents.

herbs.name: Whisperweed
herbs.description: This herb has long, slender leaves that make a soft whispering sound when wind passes through them. It grows best in secluded spots.

herbs.name: Windwhisper Grass
herbs.description: Tall and slender, this grass sways with even the gentlest breeze, producing a soft, calming sound.

herbs.name: Venomspore Lichen
herbs.description: A creeping yellow-black lichen that beads violet venom along damp limestone. It feeds on blind cave insects and releases an acrid scent when disturbed.

herbs.name: Blackwidow Mycelium
herbs.description: Hair-thin ebony fungal strands grow in the deepest fissures like a spider’s web. Their ink-dark nodules contain a paralytic essence prized by dangerous poisoners.

herbs.name: Sunwell Agave
herbs.description: This exceptionally rare succulent shelters a reservoir of luminous, amber sap behind stone-hard leaves. It grows only where underground water rises beneath scorching sands.

herbs.name: Meadowheart Clover
herbs.description: Clusters of pale four-petalled clover soften the grassland earth after rain. Its roots store a cool restorative juice used in simple healing remedies.

herbs.name: Ghostwillow Orchid
herbs.description: White, translucent blossoms grow from the roots of drowned willow trees and shine above black water. The flower’s silver nectar preserves vitality through fever and decay.

herbs.name: Rainheart Fern
herbs.description: Wide emerald fronds collect fresh rain and funnel it into a sweet, medicinal heart. The fern returns quickly after storms beneath dense tropical canopies.

herbs.name: Bittervine
herbs.description: A climbing vine with glossy purple-black berries and small hooked barbs. Its bitter sap numbs the tongue and is poisonous in concentrated form.

herbs.name: Flickerseed Pod
herbs.description: Yellow pods burst with a brief blue spark whenever they dry or split. Alchemists use the lightly charged seeds as a reactive catalyst.

herbs.name: Stoneleaf Balm
herbs.description: Thick silver-haired leaves cling to alpine cracks, surviving frost and thin soils. When crushed, they release a cooling balm that closes superficial wounds.

herbs.name: Needlewort
herbs.description: A spined yellow-flowering mountain weed whose barbs carry a mild irritant. Dried sap becomes a common poisonous preparation.

herbs.name: Wolfsbane Crest
herbs.description: Hooded blue-violet flowers gather beneath steep highland cliffs. The roots yield a potent toxin that must be collected with extreme care.

herbs.name: Siren's Blight Coral
herbs.description: Magenta branching growths glimmer turquoise where tidal caves meet the sea. Their living polyps yield either a volatile catalyst or deadly marine toxin, never both from one harvest.

herbs.name: Rimeberry
herbs.description: Frost-rimmed scarlet berries grow on low shrubs sheltered by snowdrifts. Even in deep winter, their tart juices retain a surprising restorative warmth.

herbs.name: Bitter Frostcap
herbs.description: Blue-black mushrooms emerge from frozen timber during brief thaws. Their gills hold a slow-acting toxin that remains powerful when iced.

herbs.name: Aurora Bloom
herbs.description: An iridescent crystal-petalled flower unfolds only beneath the northern lights. Its nectar stores a fleeting but profound curative energy.

herbs.name: Stormglass Lichen
herbs.description: Violet crystalline lichen forms on storm-split glacial rock. It absorbs lightning and polar winds, offering either a volatile reagent or a dangerous toxin.

herbs.name: Rootlight Moss
herbs.description: Soft pale-green moss grows around warm subterranean springs. Its faint golden glow marks a gentle curative sap even in places untouched by sunlight.

herbs.name: Gravewort
herbs.description: Dark, blade-shaped leaves push through burial soil and abandoned mine tailings. Their ashen veins carry a bitter poisonous compound.

herbs.name: Ferrospore
herbs.description: Rust-orange fungal cups cling to old iron seams and crumble into magnetic dust. Their spores react readily when mixed with other alchemical extracts.

herbs.name: Deepvein Fern
herbs.description: Pale fronds trace mineral veins through stone, pulsing blue along their stems. Its mineral-rich sap may be refined as a healing essence or a reactive tincture.

herbs.name: Blindcap
herbs.description: A sightless mushroom with curled indigo gills grows in absolute darkness. Its dusty spores carry a potent narcotic poison.

herbs.name: Voidbloom
herbs.description: Petals black as polished obsidian surround a pinprick of violet light. This strange underground flower can produce either an unusually powerful restorative essence or a planar catalyst.

herbs.name: Blackheart Spore
herbs.description: A crimson-black toadstool thrives near corrupt subterranean roots. The heart-shaped spores conceal a fiercely concentrated toxin.
